channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: DHS Secretary Defends Livestream of Fort Hood Shooter's Execution
item.description: Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin defended the Pentagon's plan to livestream the execution of an ex-Army major who was convicted.

item.title: Riyadh airport terminal struck again after deadly attack killed 12
item.description: The strike on King Khalid International Airport was the deadliest on Saudi soil in over a decade, marking a major escalation in the Yemen war.

item.title: Man attacked by tiger after entering enclosure at England wildlife park
item.description: The tigers stayed inside the enclosure and there was no danger to the public.

item.title: Russia strikes Ukraine power plant after Trump announces energy ceasefire
item.description: Ukrainian officials said a thermal power plant was struck at least twice.
